snippet.title: Dongleware Bolo (Macintosh 1994)
snippet.description: This is not the more widely known Bolo, the multiplayer tank game, but is instead a Breakout-type game by Dongleware, the creators of Oxyd. I only saw this game once back in the 90s. It seems to have different mouse button mechanics and gravity on each level. Pretty interesting.
